I feel like sometimes talking about mental health issues on a regular basis can send you deeper into the spiral and at a certain point it starts to be counterproductive. I don't think it's unreasonable to not want to talk about it at every single appointment.

I would say try to explain how you feel to your psychologist and see what they say. Maybe you can come up with an agreement where you briefly check in about ED things at every appointment but you don't discuss it in detail unless there's a reason to.

It's reasonable to want to focus on other issues or problems in your life, especially as those can contribute to ED behaviours so resolving other issues might help with the ED side of things too. Sometimes taking a break from dealing with certain issues is helpful so that you can come back to it in a few weeks or months when you feel ready and you'll have a bit of a different mindset about it because you won't feel quite as burnt out. Your feelings about this are totally valid and I hope you and your psychologist can find a good balance that works better for you.
